text: sophia: Quick a11y pass on Settings > API keys form. Issues I saw: label association inconsistent, placeholder used as label in one input, focus ring removed on inputs, and error messages not announced. kevin: ouch. which inputs specifically? sophia: name field uses label but not htmlFor, the ttl field only has placeholder '30d' and no visible label, and the secret input hides value but we don't expose aria-describedby for helper text. Also when validation fails the inline error shows visually but NVDA doesn't read it. a11y-bot: Auto-checks: missing label control association (FAIL), placeholder used as sole label (FAIL), focus-visible not present (WARN), aria-live for errors absent (WARN). tom: proposed fixes: 1) always use
